summary.text: Kurt Wuelper is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as a former state representative for Strafford 3, a seat he held from 2014 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Wuelper represented Strafford 3 in the New Hampshire House from 2014 to 2022, according to Ballotpedia.
He served on the House Judiciary Committee, and Ballotpedia lists him as clerk of that committee for 2021-2022.
He ran for Strafford 4 in 2022 and was not elected.
